assessments.reasoning: I independently retrieved and verified the exact bytes of Mini ALGOL 68 User's Guide and inspected the cited passage (§§1–2, physical PDF p. 7). In IW 32/75, §1 explicitly names ALGOL 68 as Mini’s parent and §2 says allowed constructs keep the original language’s semantics.

challenge.method: Compare the retained-construct rule with the §2 warning about context-free grammar accepting invalid combinations and the omitted constructs on printed page 2.
challenge.results: The semantics statement applies to constructs the sublanguage allows. Grammar presentation alone does not guarantee that every mechanically expressible text is valid.

limitations: This link is to the parent language as described by Ammeraal, with no all-program compilation guarantee.
